strong._note: The section 12 AI (ai/strong_ai.gd). The build order and weights were chosen by batch testing against the simple AI; see ASSUMPTIONS.md.
strong._note_growth: After the build order, late_cycle repeats for as long as money allows. A refinery is skipped while stored fuel covers fuel_reserve_rounds rounds of firing every launcher. Another launcher is bought when fuel income plus a fuel_reserve_rounds share of the stored fuel pays for firing them all each round. With skip_blocked_research, an item waiting on research is passed over instead of holding the money.

troops._note: How the strong AI uses troops. A drop goes ahead only if the value of what the march would overrun, divided by (1 + known anti-air covering the landing hex), reaches min_value. Values are per building type as the AI sees it; bunker_weights rank where to put bunkers.
troops._note_route: Each match the AI favours one troop route: airport or docks. The favoured one is researched where the airport sits in research_order; the other moves to the docks' place.

strong._note_search: search_spread: a search shot is picked at random (weighted) among aims that uncover at least (1 - search_spread) of the best aim's likely ground. 0 = always the best aim.

strongholds._note: Levels with strongholds (only troops can take them): research_first goes to the front of the research order, build_early is built right after the lab, and with silence_gun_first a known stronghold's gun is hit with a missile whenever the AI has troops to send.

nukes._note: Levels with the nuclear silo. The silo research goes first in the research order (it can't start until enough other research is done) and the bank upgrade right after the stronghold items. Once researched, a silo goes up as soon as there is money, and a nuke is built whenever the silo is empty. While a nuke is armed or being built, its fuel is kept back from other shots. A nuke is fired at the known hex whose blast scores best: values[type] for what is on the centre hex (a base there falls), ring_values[type] for each hex around it; only if the score reaches min_value. extra_labs: more labs right after the first, to reach the silo research sooner.
